text: せんとうちゅうの　ポケモンの　こうげきを　あげる　どうぐ。

structure.jp: せんとうちゅうの　ポケモンの　こうげきを　あげる
structure.en: that raises the Attack of a Pokémon in battle

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: こうげきを　あげる　どうぐ
patterns.explanation: A verb phrase placed right before a thing describes that thing. こうげきを あげる どうぐ = 'an item that raises Attack'.

patterns.name: 〜ちゅう
patterns.explanation: ちゅう stuck onto an activity means 'in the middle of' it. せんとうちゅう = 'in the middle of battle'.
